summary: Safehold Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its estimated unrealized capital appreciation (UCA) in its owned residual portfolio as of June 30, 2026, totaling $9,770 million. The filing outlines the company's policy for periodically estimating UCA from ground lease residual rights, where Safehold expects to gain title to buildings and improvements at lease expiration. This is a routine periodic disclosure of internal valuation metrics, not a special-situation event such as a transaction or strategic action. No deal terms, board actions, or advisors are mentioned. Investors may monitor whether changes in UCA signal portfolio value shifts, but no actionable corporate event is indicated.
